hook.name: CoilHook
hook.description: An ERC-20 launchpad token whose beforeSwap hook skims a fixed percentage fee (configurable up to 5%) from every swap using the beforeSwapReturnsDelta pattern, then distributes it among a protocol wallet, token holders via a MasterChef-style dividend accumulator, and a platform buy-and-burn treasury. Ownership is renounced after pool seeding, making the fee split immutable.
